title: crataegus oxyacantha var. azarella
intro: Crataegus oxyacantha var. azarella, commonly known as the hawthorn berry, is a plant species within the Rosaceae family, specifically a variant of the Crataegus oxyacantha tree. It is valued for its health benefits, which include the potential to reduce blood pressure, improve heart function, and act as an antioxidant, thereby providing cardiovascular protection. The therapeutic actions of Crataegus oxyacantha var. azarella are attributed to its ability to stimulate cardiac activity, improve blood lipid profiles, and exert vasodilatory effects, making it a promising herbal remedy for cardiovascular issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, such as quercetin and oligomeric proanthocyanidins, as well as triterpenoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
